messages.text: BL-1815 🎵 in progress — Before the model steward moves a role's seat from a Claude agent to a local-model agent (either trial boundary), the outgoing Claude seat writes a knowledge brief of at most 2000 characters that becomes the BL-1177 payload's continuitySummary and is kept at .swarmforge/agent-memory/<role>/; an owed brief that is missing, empty or over budget refuses the move, and every other agent pair crosses a trial boundary exactly as before
